about:
Precision Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1976 in Beltsville, Maryland, by its current owner with the goal of providing custom plastic fabrication services to a broad range of industries. The company began by supplying merchandise displays and custom store fixtures to large retailers before expanding into more specialized work.

Today the firm operates as a full-service plastics manufacturer offering design, engineering, and manufacturing under one roof. Its capabilities span concept development, industrial design, 3D modeling, prototyping, testing, production planning, material sourcing, and finishing services such as engraving, polishing, and assembly. Fabrications range from one-of-a-kind prototypes to short-run production in plastics, wood, laminate, and metals.

The customer base includes retail chains, the U.S. Navy (for quarter-scale rocket models), national museums requiring complex display cases and archival enclosures, scientific and microscopy facilities needing precision instrument housings, trade-show exhibitors, signage and wayfinding programs, and makers of acrylic furniture and podiums. Projects have included museum-quality cases, laboratory equipment enclosures, trade-show displays, custom podiums, and interior signage systems.

Precision Plastics attributes its differentiation to nearly 50 years of industry experience, deep material expertise, innovative technology such as 3D design and digital fabrication integration, highly skilled craftspeople, rigorous quality control, and project management that keeps jobs on time and on budget.
